note: Relay block-delivery shares and censoring classification are snapshotted from MEV Watch (mevwatch.info) as of 2026-06-22, exactly as cited in the paired article. Only individually named relays carry sourced shares; unnamed relays are honestly aggregated into 'other neutral' / 'other censoring' so the five nodes sum to 100%. No fabricated per-relay numbers.

relays.label: Ultra Sound
relays.policy: Neutral — does not screen against any sanctions list.
relays.denies: Nothing on policy grounds. Includes any valid transaction that pays the fee; ordering within the block is still the builder's call.
relays.agentNote: No exclusion risk. A filterable transaction lands the moment this relay's builder wins the slot.

relays.label: Other neutral relays
relays.policy: Aggregate of the remaining neutral relays (Agnostic, Aestus, Titan and others). None screen by OFAC list.
relays.denies: Nothing on policy grounds — same inclusion behaviour as Ultra Sound.
relays.agentNote: Safe for filterable transactions. Share is the residual of the 61.4% neutral total after Ultra Sound; individual shares are not broken out in the source snapshot.

relays.label: Other censoring relays
relays.policy: Aggregate of smaller relays that screen against the OFAC SDN list.
relays.denies: Any transaction touching a sanctioned address — silently, with no on-chain record of the refusal.
relays.agentNote: Small share, but every censoring block is a block your filterable transaction cannot enter. Residual of the 38.6% censoring total after the two bloXroute relays.

relays.label: bloXroute Max Profit
relays.policy: Censoring — screens transactions against the OFAC SDN list.
relays.denies: A flagged transaction is omitted from the block. Exclusion is not something you can outbid: unlike ordering, there is nothing to tip against.
relays.agentNote: One of the two dominant censoring relays. If your operator wallet's funding path touched a sanctioned protocol, its blocks skip you.

relays.label: bloXroute Regulated
relays.policy: Censoring — explicitly filters OFAC-sanctioned transactions by design.
relays.denies: Same as Max Profit: sanctioned transactions never enter the block, with no observable trace of the exclusion.
relays.agentNote: The other dominant censoring relay. Together with Max Profit it accounts for the bulk of the 38.6% censoring share.
